unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts the college's expectation that he teach elementary dates and the remark 'This was formal'. Without them, 'He could frankly tell the boys' now opens the paragraph with no context for the bargain. The revision also cuts the difficulty of getting students to talk at all.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The bargain remains intelligible on its own terms.

evidence.quote: This was formal; and he could frankly tell the boys that, provided they passed their examinations
The college expected him to pass at least half his time teaching the boys a few elementary dates and relations
He could frankly tell the boys that, provided they passed their examinations, they might get their facts where they liked

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's sentence 'The college expected him...' followed by 'This was formal; and'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: students may get facts where they like)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: Adams's frank deal reads as arbitrary laxity rather than a dry response to an imposed formality. The argument for 'talk' as the only privilege loses its counterweight.
unresolved_should_improve.title: The 'facts where they liked' bargain loses the college requirement it answers

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut 'One may not begin at the beginning' and the sentence about forcing his material into a shape for a method. The text therefore leaps from the Pteraspis image to 'He could think only of law as subject'. The irony of 'The course began with the beginning' is lost. The revision also cuts the hare-chasing gain and 'could not make it actual', which both qualified 'triumphant'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Merely antiquarian' still supplies the essential verdict.

evidence.quote: Adams found himself obliged to force his material into some shape to which a method could be applied.
The Pteraspis grins horribly from the closed entrance. He could think only of law as subject; the Law School as end
The Pteraspis grins horribly from the closed entrance. He could think only of law as subject; the Law School as end

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'One may not begin at the beginning... Adams found himself obliged to force his material into some shape to which a method could be applied.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: method, triumphant but leading nowhere)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The choice of law looks unmotivated. The double verdict, a real pedagogical gain that nonetheless led nowhere, is flattened.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Step from 'Pteraspis grins' to choosing law is missing

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts the image of the students' minds bursting open 'like flowers', which the first draft kept. It also cuts 'So far as it went, the answer was good, and settled one's doubts', so the Chicago answer goes straight to Adams's self-doubt. The colleagues' 'perhaps be frauds' hedge is likewise removed.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Excellent company' and the pathos of their faith survive.

evidence.quote: So far as it went, the answer was good, and settled one's doubts.
Cast more or less in the same mould, without violent emotions or sentiment, their minds burst open like flowers
for the degree of Harvard College had been rather a drawback to a young man in Boston and Washington. He still had to take for granted

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the 'burst open like flowers' clause and the 'So far as it went...' sentence.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: required (essential: students as only success; Chicago answer)
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This weakens why the students were the 'only success'. It also loses Adams's characteristic ironic acceptance of the market answer.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Students' 'flowers' image and Adams's hedged concession cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft dropped King's 'education all of a piece, yet broad'. The revision further cuts Adams's claim that he would begin again 'on a better system'. The chapter thus no longer states what King is a model of, which is a coherent education set against Adams's accidental one.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'logically, scientifically' and the 'straight line' still imply the contrast.

evidence.quote: if he were to begin again, he would do it on a better system. He thought he knew nearly what system to pursue.
but he held that it was wrong, and that, if he were to begin again, he would do it on a better system.
With this result Henry Adams's education, at his entry into life, stopped, and his life began. The editorship
He had given himself education all of a piece, yet broad.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's 'but he held that it was wrong... better system' clause, and/or the 'all of a piece' sentence.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: planning omission partly; required setup under 'model' essential
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This weakens the chapter's argumentative arc from failed education to a personified ideal. It also blunts the contrast in 'violent breaks or waves'.
unresolved_should_improve.title: King as 'model' loses the 'better system' premise

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft replaced the companion-charm paragraph with the phrase 'than charm'. The revision then cuts the 'even women' triad, the wit/energy/generosity catalogue and the Alcibiades comparison. The only remaining 'charm' is King's seeing more than others, so the contrast in 'far more vital than charm' points at the wrong quality.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The optional women's-jealousy paragraph was legitimately cut.

evidence.quote: As a companion, King's charm was great, but this was not the quality that so much attracted Adams
He had in him something of the Greek--a touch of Alcibiades or Alexander.
the charm of King was that he saw what others did and a great deal more. One Clarence King only existed in the world.
King and the Fortieth Parallel influenced him in a way far more vital than charm.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's 'His wit and humor...Nature herself' sentence and the Greek sentence. Alternatively, change 'than charm' to 'than charm of company'.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The essential 'King's qualities' are reduced to knowledge lists. 'One Clarence King only existed' is less earned, and a key comic triad in the author's voice is gone.
unresolved_should_improve.title: King portrait stripped; 'far more vital than charm' lacks its anchor

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision ends the paragraph on the general requirement of 'parallelism of life'. It cuts the image of King coming 'from the west' and Adams 'from the east' with the same problems, implements and obstacles, which the first draft kept.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'The lines of their lives converged' partly carries the idea.

evidence.quote: The one, coming from the west, saturated with the sunshine of the Sierras, met the other, drifting from the east, drenched in the fogs of London
The one, coming from the west, saturated with the sunshine of the Sierras, met the other, drifting from the east
Friendship needs a certain parallelism of life, a community of thought, a rivalry of aim.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's 'The one, coming from the west... the same obstacles to overcome.'
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The aphorism floats free of the two men. The vivid Sierras/London antithesis that dramatizes the friendship is lost.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Parallelism aphorism left unapplied; west/east convergence cut

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft cut the mining-fortune sentence. The revision also cuts the civil Government Survey and 'paralleled the Continental Railway in Geology'. 'Great success' is now backed only by a work in progress, and nothing prepares the 'richest' of the kept prediction.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The 'Whatever prize he wanted' sentence survives, and so does the prediction itself.

evidence.quote: take the pick of the gold and silver, copper or coal, and build up his fortune as he pleased
He had organized, as a civil--not military--measure, a Government Survey. He had paralleled the Continental Railway in Geology.
King's abnormal energy had already won him great success. He was creating one of the classic scientific works of the century.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the two Survey/Railway sentences and the short 'take the pick of the gold and silver...' clause.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The planned contrast of achievements with Adams's broken life weakens. The prediction's financial half reads as unmotivated.
unresolved_should_improve.title: King's achievements thinned; 'richest' unprepared
